runtime: Transformers.js 4.3.2 (bundled onnxruntime-web 1.31.0-dev.20260914) on WebGPU, driven by scripts/local-router-tune/lfm3_shim.js: chunked prefill of at most 256 tokens, the session's own KV and conv caches, sampling in JS. Installed outside the repo; nothing in src/ changes.

design.harness: browser_eval.mjs unchanged in what it asks: strategicPrompt through webgpuClient.generateContent, the advisory rubric through requestJevAdvice({ provider: 'local' }). The shim stands in as webgpuClient's engine under the id LFM3-1.7B-ONNX-q4f16, which has no web-llm profile, so generateContent takes the chat path with the shipped GENERATION_CONFIG (0.7 / top_p 0.9 / 2048) and the shipped prompt budget.
design.routing: The five queue ids are Qwen's (LOCAL_QUEUE_TOKENS); the shim maps each to the first LFM3 piece of the same queue name and returns a softmax over exactly those five, which is what web-llm's +100 logit bias does. Temperature 1, as shipped.
design.arms: 0.7 is the shipped strategy setting. 0.1 is Liquid's recommended sampling (temperature 0.1, top_k 50, repetition_penalty 1.1), applied by the shim to requests at exactly 0.1. Arms alternate per repeat in one page load: 30 strategy answers each.
design.conditions: Headless Chrome. Started only when the 1-minute load is under 3 runnable per core; if it rises above that during the run, timings are reported as invalid and accuracy stands.

rule.strategyPass: One arm hits at least 29/30 (D-019's gate) with 30/30 parsed and no focusMachine outside the plant's ids. If both arms pass, the higher hit count is the arm; a tie goes to 0.7.
rule.routingReplacesLane: At least 248/257 (D-021's gate) and test3 at least 70/75 (within 3 of the shipped lane).

outcomes.A: strategyPass and routingReplacesLane: propose that LFM3 replace both Qwen3.5-4B and the 0.8B lane, which would also retire web-llm. A [proposed] decision for Nell; nothing ships from this run.
outcomes.B: strategyPass only: not adopted as it stands, because shipping it would mean two inference runtimes (ONNX Runtime for strategy, web-llm for the lane). Report what an LFM3 routing tune would need; training one is a separate ask.
outcomes.none: The run errors, more than 2% of routing calls return unusable scores, or the smoke shows chunked and one-shot prefill disagreeing in a way that is not fp16 noise: a harness finding, no verdict.
